target_customer: Bookkeeping and accounting firms in North America
problem: Firms struggle to manage client work and month-end close across tools.
product_category: Accounting practice management and AI close software

founders.name: Kenny Song
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no prior employers

competitors.name: Canopy
competitors.what: All-in-one practice management for tax, bookkeeping and CPA firms

technical_complexity.rationale: Practice management and integrations with QuickBooks and Xero are standard SaaS; AI close agents added later.

defensibility.rationale: Firm workflows and ledger integrations create stickiness but the category had many alternatives.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No copying found; Double became an Intuit Platinum app partner in Jan 2026.

market_need_then: Accounting firms were adopting cloud tools; Double says it serves thousands of firms and 4,000+ per a 2025 release, self-reported.

branding.name_origin: Renamed from Keeper in Oct 2025; CEO says Double is inspired by double-entry bookkeeping and doubling firm productivity
branding.domain_note: Moved from keeper domain to doublehq.com in Oct 2025

rebrands.why: CEO said rebrand lets resources focus on customers, team and product; reasons beyond that not sourced

brand_strength.rationale: Rebrand got trade press coverage from CPA Practice Advisor; original name Keeper was shared with Keeper Tax and a password manager.

outcome_analysis: Keeper, now Double, grew into a bookkeeping practice management tool used by thousands of firms and raised a 6.5 million dollar Series A in December 2025 after a rebrand. Earlier funding is not documented, and the YC page shows 80 staff, which suggests capital efficiency, though no source states revenue.
notes: Business Wire releases returned 403; Series A also seen on Pulse 2.0 and Yahoo Finance via search. Totals vary ($7.88M CB Insights, $12.5M, $13M). Search found no mention of Kenny Song; his role comes from the YC page only. Competitor entries come from undated directory pages, so source_date is null and they are not dated at the batch. Pre-Series A funding unknown. Outcome search found no acquisition or layoffs. One CEO blog allegedly mentioned a lawsuit behind the rename; not confirmed.
